poem.content:
In the uniform expanse of blue
where clouds drift eastward, I wander alone
day breaks forth in august splendor wide
そしてaugust's bright truth meets my own sight

A minor melody whispers secrets by
as I roam, ready to face the tide
of existence, each step a thread
weaved in the fabric of what's left inside

In hidden places, a panther's form
emerges from the cracks of dark and storm
yet I stand firm, a badge of hope
a beacon in the mixture of light and scope

A single atom of time, suspended high
above the universe, I touch the sky
the wind's soft voice caresses my ear
whispers truths of what lies beyond, Drawing near

In fields of corn, where golden waves do glide
I find solace in the steady pace
of seasons' cycles, ebb and flow
an intricate dance, an estate to know

Here, all things merge, and I am one
with every heartbeat, one by one
where lies dissolve, and truth begins
and in the silence, I sail within.
